Free trial

![Image 1: Person in red using a computer displaying Twilio, with icons of message, person, and speech bubble.](https://www.twilio.com/aem-static/content/dam/twilio-com/global/en/products/sendgrid/rebrand/Sendgrid_hero_twilio.png/_jcr_content/renditions/compressed-original.webp)

## Same email solutions, new home base.

Don’t worry—the same SendGrid email products and services, documentation and resources you know and love are available and fully supported on[Twilio.com](https://www.twilio.com/en-us).

## Email at scale, proven deliverability, and so much more

Send email on a world-class platform that delivers more than 200 billion emails every month—and explore the rest of the Twilio Platform to build a complete solution for verification and identity, alerts, support and sales, and more.

![Image 3: Man wearing glasses using a computer to send emails in an office.](https://www.twilio.com/aem-static/content/dam/twilio-com/global/en/products/sendgrid/rebrand/Sendgrid_email-api_twilio.png/_jcr_content/renditions/compressed-original.webp)

![Image 4: Man wearing glasses using a computer to send emails in an office.](https://www.twilio.com/aem-static/content/dam/twilio-com/global/en/products/sendgrid/rebrand/Sendgrid_email-api_twilio.png/_jcr_content/renditions/compressed-original.webp)

##### Twilio SendGrid Email API and SMTP service

The trusted SendGrid Email API for delivery at scale.

![Image 5: Man with glasses smiling and pointing at something near a window](https://www.twilio.com/aem-static/content/dam/twilio-com/global/en/products/sendgrid/rebrand/Sendgrid_email-marketing_twilio.png/_jcr_content/renditions/compressed-original.webp)

##### Email campaigns for marketers

Flexible tools for creating engaging email campaigns.

## Resources to learn, build, or troubleshoot

*   Use up-to-date documentation to quickly integrate and send with our APIs. 
*   Chat with our AI assistant to get answers to your questions, troubleshoot, or find helpful information. 
*   Work with one of our trusted partners to integrate our Email API, optimize deliverability, or get help with a pre-built or custom solution. 

*   Find guidance and best practices for building with our Email API, improving deliverability, and sending great emails. 
*   Find strategic guides, insights, and research to sharpen your customer engagement strategy. 
*   See the status of our products.
